title: Is Your Data Breach Hiding In Plain Sight?
description:
When you're buying a business, especially one with offshore labor or handling sensitive customer data, you need to think beyond the basic financials. In this video, a privacy lawyer and M&A attorney break down the critical issues around data privacy, cybersecurity, and offshore labor compliance in the deal process. These aren’t just tech concerns—they’re deal-breakers if not handled right.

We’ll cover what buyers should ask, what risks are often missed, and how to protect yourself from hidden liabilities related to data handling, international labor laws, and regulatory exposure. Whether it’s GDPR, CCPA, or offshore employee contracts, this is the expert-level insight every serious buyer needs before closing a deal in 2025 and beyond.
